<function name="FindGestureLayer" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Searches the currently active layers for a layer playing animation with given activity.

<note>This function only works on <page>BaseAnimatingOverlay</page> entites!</note>
	</description>
	<added>2025.07.31</added>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="activity" type="number{ACT}">The activity to search for.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="layerID" type="number">A layer ID for given activity, or `-1` if not found.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
